meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或评估合并请求的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or assess pull request impact

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 Git 代码变更，找出修改的文件、受影响的组件和风险，并生成结构化分析报告。
howto.when: 当你需要理解 Git 差异或拉取请求中的代码变更时，可以要求 Claude 分析。

say.text: 分析当前分支的未提交变更。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并分析变更影响。

say.text: 对比 main 分支，分析这个 PR 的变更影响。
say.note: Claude 会对比 main...HEAD 并生成报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Git diffs to identify changed files, affected components, and risks, producing a structured analysis report.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to understand code changes from a Git diff or pull request.

say_en.text: Analyze uncommitted changes on the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude runs git diff and analyzes impact.

say_en.text: Compare with main branch and analyze the impact of this PR.
say_en.note: Claude compares main...HEAD and generates a report.
